verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax-filing platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only shows a browser portal ('Kein Herunterladen und Installieren'), the MeinELSTER+ app, and third-party tax software using the ERiC channel. None of it documents an official command-line interface, and the ERiC artifact host did not even respond to the probe.
